Verify One continuous asymmetrical fused fan lamina narrows to the basal point; no separated pinnae or central gingko-like split. Rounded distal scallop teeth are grouped in pairs; a straighter inner edge contrasts with expanded curved fan margin. numeric_semantics: Integer component counts in parameters are mandatory construction choices, not fossil universals. All lengths, radii, thicknesses, widths and bounds are nominal artistic inputs; final transformed world geometry must be measured and disclosed. No normalization is planned, so component scale is preserved except grounding/centering translation.
contact_policy: Leaf/pinna/frond bases and root bundles must genuinely contact their supporting axis or lamina, with geometric penetration below the visible surface permitted. Measure actual world-space tagged vertex groups; inspect branching junctions and veins in multiple diagnostic directions. No visible coplanar surface interference.
